name: minimal-pi-desktop-harness
description: A minimal multi-session desktop harness for Pi Coding Agent
author: Minimal Pi Harness contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:node && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.release:verify:desktop: npm run release:verify && npm run smoke:desktop
scripts.release:verify:full: npm run release:verify:desktop && npm run probe:compat
scripts.dist:mac: npm run release:verify && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:signed: npm run release:verify && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --config.mac.notarize=true
scripts.dist:win: npm run release:verify && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run release:verify && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64
